evals.prompt: Audit https://example.com to verify pricing and product lifecycle consistency across all pages.
evals.expected_output: Scoped fact ledger and list of detected cross-page contradictions.
assertions: Price conflicts are only flagged when entity, currency, and interval match
Discontinued vs active product lifecycle mismatches are reported
Footer copyright year variations are emitted as freshness recommendations

evals.prompt: Detect cross-page price discrepancies between product detail pages and catalog listings on https://example.com.
evals.expected_output: List of conflicting price facts for identical product entities.
assertions: Different price values on product vs catalog page trigger FIRST_PARTY_FACT_CONFLICT
Multi-tier pricing on the same page is not flagged as a conflict
European and multi-currency formats are normalized before comparison
